object_description: compact five-storey building with green inner courtyard
design_condition: The compact building is set back from the street and arranged with existing buildings to preserve their presence, maximize open space, and create parks, a public staircase, and a green courtyard that integrate the large volume into the urban landscape.

positive.statement: The particularly compact placement leaves generous parking and open space around the historic buildings.
The minimized footprint generates maximum open space for a new park and contributes to the local climate.
The small square and restaurants significantly improve the quality of stay.
The openness, lightness and permeability of the sculptural facade integrate the building into the surrounding development.
The existing buildings are handled very carefully.
The green inner courtyard creates a symbolic center, brings light inside, regulates the internal climate, and provides orientation and meeting space.
The atrium as a compact distributor ensures flexibility, overview and easy orientation.
The ecological construction and resource-saving operation form a convincing architectural expression.
The compact shape and high space efficiency are economically convincing.
The building creates urban calm and gives the institution an independent forward-looking identity.

negative.statement: The thematic derivation of the inner garden seems somewhat artificial.
How existing trees are to be dealt with has not been clearly clarified.
The simple building structure sometimes results in long distances and suboptimal operational processes for patients.
